nbis.headline: Bear narrative stacked Monday: Motley Fool says ~4/5 of the ~$40B commitment backlog is Microsoft + Meta; TipRanks on concentration and dilution fears ($5.75B converts); IBD report (via GuruFocus) that Michael Burry added to his NBIS short.
nbis.why: No new facts, but concentration + convert overhang is the live bear case. Meta's Muse momentum (below) is the offset to the concentration worry.

nbis.headline: Read-across: Nvidia's >$500B third-party AI-infra financing push (Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman, KKR; GPUs as collateral, Nvidia backstop up to 25% residual) faces lender pushback on GPU depreciation; some want a thicker cushion.
nbis.why: Neocloud funding cost depends on how lenders value GPUs. Tighter collateral terms = higher NBIS financing cost. Watch, not FLAG.

soWhat: NBIS −4.2% on a record Nasdaq day is supply + narrative (RSU tax sales, Nave 500k 10b5-1, Burry short), not new fundamentals.
Real risks to watch: customer concentration (MSFT+META), $5.75B convert overhang, GPU-collateral financing terms.
Sector demand still strong (Foxconn record, NVDA record, Meta Muse), but power/permit delays are the new drag for memory and neoclouds.
10Y at 5.31% (2002 high) is the macro ceiling; F&G 43 Fear with breadth in extreme fear. No trade action.
